title: The Traditional Vi
summary: The Traditional Vi (ex-vi) is the official historical archive of Bill Joy's original vi editor implementation from 1976, maintained as a reference for the classic Unix text editor that revolutionized terminal-based text editing.
problem_solved: Preserves and documents the original vi editor source code and behavior for historical reference and educational purposes.
why_valuable: Provides authentic historical software preservation of one of the most influential text editors in computing history, enabling developers to study and understand the original implementation.
